about_short_description.short_description: Talos is an end-to-end crypto trading platform that provides digital asset trading technology for lenders, brokers, and investors.

product.name: Trading Platform
product.description: Institutional digital-asset trading software for price discovery, execution, allocation, reporting, and trade-lifecycle management across multiple venues and portfolios.

product.name: Portfolio & Risk Management
product.description: Portfolio management software that provides real-time positions, balances, P&L, exposure, reconciliation, and risk oversight across digital-asset portfolios and venues.

product.name: White Label
product.description: API- and GUI-based infrastructure that enables brokers, banks, custodians, neobanks, and investment platforms to offer digital-asset trading under their own brand.

product.name: Treasury & Settlement
product.description: Operational infrastructure for digital-asset treasury, credit, working-capital, custody transfers, settlement, reconciliation, and monitoring across counterparties and venues.

product.name: Portfolio Construction
product.description: Systematic investment software for building, implementing, rebalancing, and managing customized digital-asset portfolios at institutional scale.

product.name: Post-Trade Analytics
product.description: Trade and execution analytics for measuring transaction costs, market impact, fill quality, execution performance, and liquidity-source outcomes.
